description: This file contains Redux action creators and async functions for managing team-related operations in Mattermost, including fetching, creating, updating, deleting teams, managing team members, and handling team invites.

methods.name: getProfilesAndStatusesForMembers
methods.description: Fetches profiles and statuses for a list of user IDs, dispatching actions to load missing profiles and statuses.

methods.name: selectTeam
methods.description: Creates an action to select a team by ID or object.

methods.name: getMyTeams
methods.description: Fetches the list of teams the current user belongs to.

methods.name: getMyTeamUnreads
methods.description: Fetches unread counts for the current user's teams, with error handling.

methods.name: getTeam
methods.description: Fetches details of a team by ID.

methods.name: getTeamByName
methods.description: Fetches team details by team name.

methods.name: getTeams
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of teams, with optional total count.

methods.name: searchTeams
methods.description: Searches for teams based on a search term and options, returning either a list or count.

methods.name: createTeam
methods.description: Creates a new team and adds the current user as an admin and user.

methods.name: deleteTeam
methods.description: Deletes a team by ID, emitting events and resetting channel selection if current team.

methods.name: unarchiveTeam
methods.description: Unarchives a team by ID.

methods.name: updateTeam
methods.description: Updates team details.

methods.name: patchTeam
methods.description: Partially updates team details.

methods.name: regenerateTeamInviteId
methods.description: Regenerates the invite ID for a team.

methods.name: getMyTeamMembers
methods.description: Fetches the current user's team memberships and loads roles.

methods.name: getTeamMembers
methods.description: Fetches members of a team with pagination.

methods.name: getTeamMember
methods.description: Fetches a specific team member and loads profiles and statuses.

methods.name: getTeamMembersByIds
methods.description: Fetches multiple team members by user IDs.

methods.name: getTeamsForUser
methods.description: Fetches teams for a specific user.

methods.name: getTeamMembersForUser
methods.description: Fetches team memberships for a specific user.

methods.name: getTeamStats
methods.description: Fetches statistics for a team.

methods.name: addUserToTeamFromInvite
methods.description: Adds a user to a team via an invite token.

methods.name: addUserToTeam
methods.description: Adds a user to a team and updates profiles and memberships.

methods.name: addUsersToTeamGracefully
methods.description: Adds multiple users to a team, handling errors and updating profiles.

methods.name: removeUserFromTeam
methods.description: Removes a user from a team, updating profiles and handling current user removal.

methods.name: sendEmailInvitesToTeam
methods.description: Sends email invites to a team.

methods.name: sendEmailGuestInvitesToChannels
methods.description: Sends guest email invites to channels.

methods.name: sendEmailInvitesToTeamGracefully
methods.description: Gracefully sends email invites to a team.

methods.name: sendEmailGuestInvitesToChannelsGracefully
methods.description: Gracefully sends guest email invites to channels.

methods.name: sendEmailInvitesToTeamAndChannelsGracefully
methods.description: Gracefully sends email invites to a team and channels.

methods.name: getTeamInviteInfo
methods.description: Fetches information about a team invite.

methods.name: checkIfTeamExists
methods.description: Checks if a team exists by name.

methods.name: setTeamIcon
methods.description: Sets a team icon image.

methods.name: removeTeamIcon
methods.description: Removes a team icon.

methods.name: updateTeamScheme
methods.description: Updates the scheme of a team.

methods.name: updateTeamMemberSchemeRoles
methods.description: Updates roles for a team member's scheme.

methods.name: invalidateAllEmailInvites
methods.description: Invalidates all email invites.

methods.name: membersMinusGroupMembers
methods.description: Fetches team members excluding group members.

methods.name: getInProductNotices
methods.description: Fetches in-product notices for a team.

methods.name: updateNoticesAsViewed
methods.description: Marks notices as viewed.
